Use case: ui-mockup. This supplied SIDEQUEST revision2 teen dashboard is the exact layout, artwork, palette and spacing reference. Create one flat front-on full desktop UI frame at1440x1200,6:5 landscape. No browser, device or presentation frame. Keep the cozy forest-green #233F35 sidebar, ivory #F5F2E9 content, sage #A9BA96, muted gold #D6AD58, charcoal #24312B, thin warm-gray borders, original pixel artwork where applicable. Preserve GENEROUS SPACE:40px main outer margin,28-32px card gaps,28-32px card inner padding,16px between headings and supporting content,24px between logical groups. Main contents must fit without crowding and no clipping. Art stays a restrained horizontal band; use extra height for breathing room.

CRITICAL TYPOGRAPHIC RULES FROM USER: ALL MAIN HEADINGS AT ALL LEVELS H1,H2,H3 MUST BE 8-BIT. Use ONE coherent rounded 8-bit display font family inspired by Pixelify Sans Medium, mixed-case readable stepped-pixel letterforms with open counters. Use this same pixel font for greeting, page title, goal title, all card/section titles, and modal title. No serif anywhere and no regular smooth sans titles. Three clear heading levels: H1 primary page title32-34px, H2 quest or major section26-28px, H3 card titles20-22px. If long, wrap neatly rather than shrinking/cramming. Smaller pixel headings must still be crisp, legible and consistent. Logo stays pixel. Pair with ONE clean humanist sans like Inter for all SUBTITLES, body explanations, navigation, metadata, inputs, buttons, badges and all MONEY figures. Body15-16px400, line height1.5; control15px500-600, metadata13px, money tabular semibold (hero44px, wallet/interest34px). Don't make all body copy bold. Pixel type is only for headings; normal sans digits for money. No extra fonts. This two-family pixel/sans pairing, heading size hierarchy and relaxed padding must be clearly visible. No new features.
EDIT THIS EXISTING TEEN DASHBOARD without changing anything except applying the critical typography rule. EVERY heading, including 'Hey, Alex', 'Your next adventure', 'PS5 Quest', 'Your wallet', 'Next monthly boost', 'Watch your savings grow', 'Recent activity', must use the SAME harmonious 8-bit pixel font family. Hierarchy: page title34px, greeting26px,goal title28px,card titles20-22px. Keep all spacing and artwork of source. Keep exact balances $399.30 of$500.00,80%saved,$100.70to go,$125.00wallet,+$39.93next interest,10%monthly,ParentfundCovered. Chart Start$300,M1$330,M2$363,M3$399.30;statsDeposited$300,Withdrawn$0,Interestearned$99.30. Activity interest36.30Month3,33.00Month2,30.00Month1. Same sidebar SIDEQUEST,Overview,Activity,Howitworks,Demo money. Same controls Addtosavings,Withdraw,Adddemofunds and simulationMonth3PausedPlay10s/month. No content removed or changed. In particular all7 named headings must visibly be 8-bit; their subtitles and figures must not be pixelated.
